user.title: Add a Zendure set
user.description: ZEM reads the set over the local network. Nothing is written to the set in this version.

serial_mismatch.title: Different set at the address of set {number}
serial_mismatch.description: The device at {host} reports a different serial number than set {number}. ZEM does not use it. Check the IP address of the set (for example a fixed address in your router), or remove set {number} and add it again.

init.title: Sources
init.description: Choose the sensor of your grid meter (P1) in W, + for import. ZEM runs in shadow mode: it computes what it would do, but does not control the battery yet.

data_description.p1_entity: A meter that reports every second controls best. With corrections (EV, air conditioning) you can choose the corrected sensor of your current setup.
